rationale: Plan step 7 (figure4_compare.py, verifies C14) produced output/figure4.json with corr_X_EU=0.8503 and mean_logdiff_X_EU=0.5862 (i.e. X_t averages ~58.6 log points above Lambda^EU) on the overlapping quarterly sample 1967.25-2004.75 (n=151 quarters). The paper reports a correlation of 0.83 (replicated 0.8503; 2.4% relative error, within 5%) and a level difference of 56 log points = 0.56 log units (replicated 0.586 log units / 58.6 log points; 4.7% relative error, within 5%). Both quantities fall inside the 5% match band. The one fix flagged in fix_severity.json concerns an opt-in --splice_tail sample-extension for the 1948-2010 full-sample results and does not affect this overlapping-sample cross-check.
